text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'Murder Mystery'...
To continue the game, the members gathered once again.
At the end of the previous session, if I recall—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, until we were gathered here,
I was with Grass-chan after she finished serving dinner, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For just a split second, I caught a glimpse
of Sei-chan walking while carrying something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to the secret revealed by Special Week,
suspicion fell upon Seiun Sky.
However, she...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan's statement is true. Indeed, I was
walking through the mansion carrying something.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then, last time Sei-chan readily admitted
to Spe-chan's testimony, didn't she?
Do you have some kind of plan in mind?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all~.
It was a fact, so I just confirmed it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, would you mind listening to my secret?
It's a pretty important one.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: An important one...? I want to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I happened to catch a glance
at Grass-chan's smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And to my surprise... there was plant-based poison
in her purchase history.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Eek...!! Poison...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Grass-chan was the one who had the poison all along
and spiked the food. But she hesitated, knowing that serving it directly
would get her caught.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
However, King just happened to leave her room empty.
And El had visited just beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thinking she could pin the blame on El,
Grass-chan visited the room once more
and swapped the bowls... How about that?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Then the one who's truly suspicious
is Grass...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? But if I remember correctly, Grass-chan was—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that's right. By the way, the 'Crash!' sound
was King accidentally dropping the bowl after taking a bite of the poison.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Being nearby, I rushed into the guest room in a hurry
and noticed King's state.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And then, I was about to call everyone over,
but thought the shattered chawanmushi bowl was dangerous,
so I cleaned it up.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In short, what Spe-chan saw was me in the middle of cleaning up.
Nothing suspicious about it at all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that is your argument. ...However,
there is no proof that your testimony just now is true, is there?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nope, none at all.
Though that's for everyone else to judge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Seiun Sky smirked, turning it into what looked like a duel between the two,
the alarm signaling the end of Phase II rang out.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh...! Both Sei-chan and Grass
are totally suspicious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing what has been said so far—
who should I vote for...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of the vote—
Seiun Sky was deemed the culprit with the majority vote.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Aw, man, couldn't fool you, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I'm the culprit. Though to be fair,
it was kind of accidental.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, during the day, I cleaned the guest room King was staying in.
But I accidentally left my broom behind back then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that King had left her room empty,
I tried to secretly retrieve it.
And then, I knocked over the broom...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And 'Crash!' went the chawanmushi bowl, shattered.
So I grabbed the chawanmushi in the blue bowl from the kitchen
and swapped it out, without knowing it was poisoned. That's how it went.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
claiming that I 'visited the room once more and swapped the bowls'
was quite a smooth bluff.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You also revealed that I possessed the poison at a very effective
moment. However—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The stones float and the leaves sink... In the end,
your bluff didn't match Spe-chan's testimony
that she was with me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's where the contradiction showed.
...Guess I gotta do better next time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how wonderful~.
I would certainly love to match wits with you again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the truth safely uncovered,
the curtain fell on the murder mystery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of the vote—the votes were split,
and Seiun Sky was not deemed the culprit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we couldn't figure out who the culprit was.
Hmm, this leaves such an unsettled feeling~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, ending on a totally baseless conclusion like this
is just part of a murder mystery.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of us was quite the liar.
...Let's definitely play again sometime.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! 
El didn't tell any lies, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, next time, I would certainly like
to uncover who the real liar was~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —*Gasp*!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is it over?! It's finally over, isn't it?!
I thought I wouldn't be able to breathe for the rest of my life...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, King. Welcome back to the land of the living~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who the real culprit was... perhaps
Seiun Sky and Grass Wonder
already knew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of the vote—
Grass Wonder was deemed the culprit with the majority vote.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my, oh my, this is...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How unfortunate. It seems everyone was deceived.
...By Sei-chan's lie, that is.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Or rather than a lie, perhaps a bluff.
In any case, I am not the culprit~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡¿Qué?! Is that true?!
I couldn't tell which was a lie at all...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well, maybe Grass-chan really isn't
the true culprit, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...What I said wasn't necessarily
a complete lie, you know?
After all, they say no smoke without fire.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, while that is quite cryptic,
it is rather intriguing as well~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, well... let's just say
we're even on that front~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who the real culprit was... perhaps
Seiun Sky and Grass Wonder
already knew all along.
